title: PluginEditor assembly — view modes, header, resizing, wiring, CMakeLists
description:
Fan-in task: assemble ShredEQAudioProcessorEditor layout with global header, view modes, EQWorkspace, InspectorPanel, IntelligenceDrawer, LookAndFeel, resize policy, and CMakeLists registration. Sole owner of Source/PluginEditor.* and CMakeLists.txt in phase J per async_notes.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §13.1 window behavior, §13.2 global header, §13.7 view modes (Sculpt/Diagnose/Dynamics), §13.8 interaction (undo/redo, magnifiers already handled in children)
- Source/PluginEditor.* skeleton from phase A
- Source/UI/ShredEQLookAndFeel.*, EQWorkspace.*, BandNode.*, InspectorPanel.*, IntelligenceDrawer.* public APIs from j.1–j.4
- Source/PluginProcessor.h for APVTS, analyzer snapshot accessors, createEditor
- Source/StateManager.* A/B and preset APIs if present
- CMakeLists.txt target_sources append patterns from prior phases

Implement Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp:
1. Own ShredEQLookAndFeel (setDefaultLookAndFeel / setLookAndFeel on editor); restore on destruction.
2. Default size ~1360×820; setResizeLimits min ~980×620; setResizable(true, true); high-DPI via default JUCE affine — no custom DPI hacks required beyond Desktop scale awareness.
3. Global header row controls (wire to APVTS/StateManager where IDs/APIs exist): preset browser hook, profile selector, tuning selector, A/B switch, copy A→B, undo/redo buttons (AudioProcessorEditor undo manager or processor-provided), global bypass, gain-matched bypass/audition, analyzer enable, latency readout, CPU indicator stub, help/menu buttons.
4. View mode switcher: Sculpt | Diagnose | Dynamics. EQ curve remains visible in all modes; Diagnose emphasizes percentile/resonance/dynamic-range overlays on EQWorkspace; Dynamics emphasizes multiband zones / detector / sidechain collision overlay flags. Mode only toggles overlay flags and optional non-EQ panels — does not remove the EQ curve.
5. Layout: header top; IntelligenceDrawer left or right; EQWorkspace center; InspectorPanel bottom full width under workspace (drawer may span full height or leave test room — document choice in comments).
6. Wire workspace selection → InspectorPanel::setSelectedBand; timer/callback (~30–60 Hz UI) to pull response curves and analyzer snapshots from processor without audio-thread work in editor paint beyond reading latest atomics/snapshots.
7. Keyboard: Delete forwards to workspace remove-selected; undo/redo keys if host allows.

CMakeLists.txt:
1. Append Source/UI/ShredEQLookAndFeel.cpp, EQWorkspace.cpp, BandNode.cpp, InspectorPanel.cpp, IntelligenceDrawer.cpp and ensure PluginEditor.cpp remains listed.
2. Append-only minimal edits — no target renames or preset churn.

Do not rewrite DSP modules or ParameterIDs inventory. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp construct ShredEQAudioProcessorEditor with LookAndFeel installed and default size approximately 1360x820
Editor setResizeLimits (or equivalent) enforce minimum approximately 980x620 and remain user-resizable
Editor hosts EQWorkspace, InspectorPanel, and IntelligenceDrawer in resized() layout with a global header row
View modes Sculpt, Diagnose, and Dynamics exist and keep the EQ curve visible while changing diagnostic/dynamics overlay emphasis
Selected band in EQWorkspace updates InspectorPanel
CMakeLists.txt lists ShredEQLookAndFeel.cpp, EQWorkspace.cpp, BandNode.cpp, InspectorPanel.cpp, and IntelligenceDrawer.cpp on the plugin target
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: rewrite Source/UI/ShredEQLookAndFeel.* / EQWorkspace.* / BandNode.* / InspectorPanel.* / IntelligenceDrawer.* algorithms beyond include/use (those tasks own implementation)
modify Source/PluginProcessor.* unless a one-line createEditor/accessor is already missing — prefer existing processor APIs; do not take DSP ownership
broad CMake restructure or rename targets
implement new DSP modules in this task

allowed: Sculpt/Diagnose/Dynamics enum driving EQWorkspace overlay flags
UI timer for curve/analyzer snapshot refresh
append-only CMake target_sources for phase-J UI cpp files
header controls as stubs when StateManager/APVTS IDs missing with TODOs
forbidden: moving processBlock logic into the editor
second FFT owner in the GUI
